Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class ReleaseModelEvidence

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.ReleaseModelEvidence
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ReleaseModelEvidence extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable applicability and validation-evidence manifest for a release-flow model.

A manifest records what has been checked without converting software tests into engineering qualification. Current built-in models remain UNQUALIFIED; an independent evidence record identifies evidence produced outside the model implementation, but does not by itself authorize a qualified status.

      public ReleaseModelEvidence(String manifestId, List<String> applicability, List<String> limitations, List<ReleaseModelEvidence.Record> records)
      Creates an unqualified evidence manifest.
      Parameters:
      manifestId - stable manifest identifier including model/version context
      applicability - stable codes for represented regimes
      limitations - stable codes for excluded or unqualified regimes
      records - analytical, conservation, numerical or experimental evidence references
